speaker: ramona_nowitzki
text: Again, ew. You know, I'd love to hear more about how you intend to add neutrinos. Could we get a cup of coffee sometime?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I don't drink coffee.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I do. I love me a cup of joe.

speaker: ramona_nowitzki
text: Well, it doesn't have to be coffee. How about dinner? Great. I know a terrific little Italian place.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I do eat dinner.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I never eat in strange restaurants. One runs the risk of non-standard cutlery.

speaker: ramona_nowitzki
text: Excuse me?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sheldon lives in fear of the three-tined fork.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Three tines is not a fork, three tines is a trident. Forks are for eating, tridents are for ruling the seven seas.

speaker: ramona_nowitzki
text: What if I brought food to your place?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: That would be acceptable. On Mondays, I eat Thai food. Mee krob and chicken sate with extra peanut sauce from Siam Palace.

speaker: ramona_nowitzki
text: You got it. I already have your address.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: What a nice girl.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Sheldon, do you have any idea what just happened?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Yes. Apparently I'm getting a free dinner.

speaker: penny
text: Oh, yeah, no, this thing's majorly out of order. See? Sorry.

speaker: ramona_nowitzki
text: That's okay. Guess I'm taking the stairs. 4-A.

speaker: penny
text: Where you going? Oh, are you here to see Leonard?

speaker: ramona_nowitzki
text: No, Dr. Cooper.

speaker: penny
text: Dr. Sheldon Cooper?

speaker: ramona_nowitzki
text: We're having dinner.

speaker: penny
text: Sheldon Cooper? Tall, thin, looks a little like a giant praying mantis?

speaker: ramona_nowitzki
text: He is cute, isn't he?
